note: Trail Appliances Sales Order Confirmation -- the B8 reproduction. In production the ROUTER categorised this 'other', so no child analyzer ran and every field came back null (REJECT_B2_OTHER_CATEGORY); the fix is the code-side B2 rescue in gates.apply_b2_rescue. || IMPORTANT: this sidecar does NOT reproduce that bug. regress.py provisions generalinvoicetest and calls the CHILD analyzer directly, so the router is never invoked and routingDecision here is HAPPY_PATH_CANDIDATE, not the REJECT or the REVIEW_B2_RESCUED the live pipeline now returns. It anchors the EXTRACTION that the rescue recovers; the routing half has no golden-corpus coverage by construction. || invoice_date 2026-08-27 is the printed 'Order Date: 08/27/2026'. The CU twins are unreliable on it -- observed both agreeing at 0.417/0.358 (below the 0.73 bar, carried only by agreement) and, on another run, extract null with generate at 0.316, which FAILED and defaulted to today. That was defect A6, invisible only because the document was processed on its own order date. It is now stable code-side: find_invoice_date_in_text reads it from the printed label (resolution source 'printed_label'), so this assertion holds whichever way the twins fall, and from 2026-08-28 it is what catches a regression back to the today-default. || payment_due_date 2026-09-26 is DEFAULTED (invoice_date + 30), not printed -- the page states 'Payment Terms: NET30' and no calendar date, and the analyzer prompt refuses to infer one. It is asserted because it is stable and arithmetically checkable (NET30 from 08/27), and it locks the +30 rule; it is not an extraction. || amount_excluding_gst 1107.42 verified by arithmetic (1159.17 - 51.75). || account_number is the printed 'Cust. #: 264100C'. || sub_bill_type 'repair' follows from the PO prefix 11 (sha 23c36a9). || Verifiable absences: no billing period is printed, so start/end/number_of_days are ''. || NOT asserted, measured UNSTABLE across 3 replicates at --add time: invoice_number (S000091581 twice, null once -- the page prints 'Order: S000091581' and no invoice number), invoice_description, diagnosis_solution, diagnosis_solution_zh_hant, and warranty (full disclaimer text twice, '' once -- page 2 is a Terms and Conditions page, which is also what collided with the word 'contracts' in the router's `other` description).
